items.line: Season-ending finals open next Sunday with Sinner and Alcaraz among the qualifiers, plus Zverev, Shelton, Cobolli, Fils and Tiafoe. Semifinals Nov 21, final Nov 22 (15:00 local, per third-party schedules; verify).
